marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure CapEx
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech companies maintain high capital expenditure guidance for AI infrastructure, driving strong quarterly shipments for cloud hardware suppliers.
marketLayer.inference: Semiconductor and server supply chains will continue to enjoy strong revenue support in the near term, though margin pressure may increase for hyperscalers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace and software ROI timeline for enterprise AI adoption.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Platform Buybacks & Local Services
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed internet majors sustained aggressive share repurchase programs alongside steady expansion in core local commercial operations.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerated buybacks offer downside valuation support while firms pivot toward higher-efficiency core business segments.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Overall pace of domestic macroeconomic consumer confidence recovery.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Treasury Yield Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: US inflation metrics showed further moderation, stabilizing the 10-year Treasury yield as rate-cut expectations re-anchor for upcoming FOMC meetings.
marketLayer.inference: Easing rate pressures create favorable liquidity conditions for growth stocks and capital inflows into Asia-Pacific equity markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky service sector inflation or energy price volatility disrupting easing trajectories.
